name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
blurb: Theme switcher with View Transition API animations and direction options.
description: Primitive component for theme management with optional View Transition API animations. Accepts theme state and direction prop to customize clip animation path.
use_when: Building theme switchers that need smooth transitions between light/dark/system modes with directional animations.
avoid_when: When View Transition API is not supported or when browser compatibility is a concern.
a11y: Render function receives theme state and toggleTheme callback. Accessibility depends on how the render function is implemented.
